Question B-005-001-004.

Why the correct answer is right: One microfarad equals 1 000 000 picofarads, so the value is 1 microfarad.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "10 microfarads": That answer would result from shifting the decimal one place too far right when converting 1 000 000 pF to microfarads.
- sourceIndex 2: "0.01 microfarads": This is one hundred times too small.
- sourceIndex 3: "0.001 microfarads": This is one thousand times too small.
